payload.text:
To get the best results from Manus AI, you need a prompt that acts as a "Creative Brief." It should define the structure, the local context of Kitengela, and the specific services you offer.

Copy and paste the detailed prompt below into Manus AI to build your professional agency website.

Manus AI Website Builder Prompt
Role: You are a world-class Web Designer and Conversion Strategist. Project Goal: Create a high-converting, mobile-responsive service website for my agency: "Kitengela Digital Growth Partner."

1. Target Audience: Small to medium business owners in Kitengela, Kenya (located along Namanga Highway, Chuna Mall, OBC Mall). These include Barbershops, Restaurants, Hardware stores, and Pharmacies.

2. Visual Style:

Theme: Modern, tech-forward, and professional.

Colors: Deep Charcoal, Electric Blue, and White.

Vibe: Clean, fast-loading, and trustworthy. Use high-quality imagery of smartphones, local business environments, and growth charts.

3. Website Structure & Content:

Header: Logo (text-based: Kitengela Digital), Navigation (Services, Free Audit, Contact).

Hero Section: * Headline: "Is Your Kitengela Business Invisible Online?"

Sub-headline: "We help businesses along Namanga Highway automate their sales, rank #1 on Google, and get more customers using AI and WhatsApp funnels."

Primary CTA: Button: "Get a Free Digital Health Audit" (Link to WhatsApp: 0717 578 394).

The Problem Section: * Highlight: "Don't let walk-ins be your only revenue. In Kitengela, your customers are searching on their phones. If they don't find you, they find your competitor."

Service Pillars (The "How"):

Google Maps Dominance: Ranking you #1 for "near me" searches.

WhatsApp Automation: Bots that handle bookings and orders 24/7.

Meta & Google Ads: Hyper-local targeting within Kitengela.

Digital Style Guides: Making your brand look premium.

Sector-Specific Solutions (Interactive Grid):

Beauty/Grooming: AI Booking systems to fill empty chairs.

Food/Hospitality: WhatsApp menus and automated ordering.

Retail/Hardware: Digital catalogs and high-intent search ads.

Health: Stock-check bots and appointment scheduling.

The Lead Magnet (The "Offer"):

A section titled: "Claim Your Free 5-Point Digital Health Audit."

We check: 1. Google Maps Accuracy, 2. Mobile Speed, 3. WhatsApp Funnel readiness, 4. Competitor Ranking, 5. Social Media Engagement.

Footer: * Phone/WhatsApp: 0717 578 394

Tagline: "Your Local Kitengela Digital Growth Partner."

Location: Serving Kitengela, Athi River, and Kajiado County.

4. Technical Requirements:

Direct "Click-to-Chat" WhatsApp integration on all buttons.

Mobile-first design (most local owners use their phones).

SEO optimized for keywords like "Digital Marketing Kitengela," "WhatsApp Bots Kenya," and "Google Maps SEO Kitengela."

Your "Free Digital Health Audit" (The Checklist)
Since you’ll be mentioning this on the website and your posters, here is the 5-point checklist you will actually use when they call you:

Google Maps Pin: "Is your business pin accurate, and do you have at least 5 recent 5-star reviews?"

WhatsApp Professionalism: "Are you using a Personal account or a Business account with a catalog and 'Away' messages set up?"

Search Visibility: "When I search for [Your Industry] in Kitengela, do you appear in the top 3 results?"

Content Consistency: "Have you posted a high-quality photo or video of your work in the last 7 days?"

Response Time: "How long does it take for a new customer to get a price list or book an appointment?"

**Designing a Digital Hub**

I'm currently focused on the agency website design for "Kitengela Digital Growth Partner." I'm aiming for a modern aesthetic, keeping the Kitengela, Kenya location in mind. I'm exploring the colour palette of Deep Charcoal, Electric Blue, and White. I'm visualizing a hub that attracts businesses like barbershops, restaurants, hardware stores, and pharmacies.


**Developing the Website Structure**

I've moved beyond the initial aesthetic focus and am now deep into the structural design. I'm prioritizing a mobile-first approach, and the framework is built on React 18+ with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide React icons. I'm exploring Framer Motion for tech-forward animations. The file structure is also taking shape. I've got key components mapped out like Navbar, Hero, Problem, Services, SectorSolutions, AuditSection, and Footer. I'm thinking about SEO keywords for better searchability.


**Crafting Specific Website Elements**

I'm now diving into the finer details. The Navbar will be sticky and have a glassmorphism effect. The Hero section will feature high-contrast, bold text, while the Problem section gets a dark background with emotive copy. I've designed Service cards and a SectorSolutions grid with industry examples, plus a structured audit checklist. I'm integrating a WhatsApp link, and Lucide-React is my go-to for relevant icons.
